stock-vivo-geographic-overlay: Fixed the legacy geographic overlay: offset.y was -72, which the engine (and the frozen web oracle) read as 72 units *below* the canvas, so the model and time lines overlapped and the date was clipped. The style now declares +72 (the same inset convention every other bottom overlay uses); the new frame stacks model + time fully inside the photo. The oracle golden still shows the clipped legacy frame, so a golden diff here is expected.
glass-pill-5: 玻璃 05 (glassSideCard, height-driven) now derives its canvas from the composition instead of the declared 1.4971: canvas aspect = card aspect x (cardHeightPct/100) / ((1 - 2*cardInsetPct/100) * cardMaxWidthPct/100) = photo aspect x 2.1692, and the card follows the photo (cardFit=photo) so it is no longer cover-cropped. Canonical 4:3 sample: canvas is now 2667x922 (2.89:1) instead of the golden's 2667x1781 (1.4971). The composition itself is unchanged - photo starts at 45.93% of the width, card is 40.89%W / 88.7%H, 5.65% vertical padding - so the golden diff is a deliberate canvas change, not a layout regression. See evidence/glass-aspect-20261123/.
